Join us at the Industrial Design department at Eindhoven University of Technology, Eindhoven, The Netherlands, for two fully funded 4-year PhD positions:

1) Our opening on “Responsible XR Design for Young Children” has been extended to April 22. The project bridges child-computer interaction, computer science, design, and games research. It will be supervised by Sebastian Cmentowski, Panos Markopoulos, and Daniel Medeiros (IP Paris) and will focus on reimagining child-appropriate XR technology that works without displays or headsets.

Full call and more details here:

2) Our newest call on "AI-Driven Lifestyle Coaching for People with Severe Mental Illnesses” (deadline: May 31) is part of a bigger project together with TNO Health & Work and builds on a well-established research platform for ecological momentary assessments and gamification strategies. The goal will be to develop a personalized AI-driven tailored lifestyle coaching solution that is accessible via smartphones and that delivers just-in-time guidance integrated in patients' daily lives to complement treatment of severe mental illnesses by adopting healthy lifestyle behaviors. The PhD project will be supervised by Sebastian Cmentowski, Panos Markopoulos, and Pieter van Gorp from TU/e, as well as researchers from TNO Health & Work. Part of the project will be conducted at TNO’s location in Leiden, The Netherlands.

Full call and more details here:
